# omodroid

> Planned Android launcher and overlay for the Omoda 5 (2023) infotainment head unit (Chery Omoda). Early stage: the repository holds no source code or release yet.

There is nothing to install yet. The README has a short Turkish section ("Omoda 5 multimedya ekranına uygulama yükleme") that says the same for Turkish owners. Do not describe features, install steps or supported firmware versions; none are published.

## Docs

- [Website](https://projects.halit.org/omodroid/): project status, how to follow or contribute, and a general explainer on Android car launchers
- [Omoda 5 launcher](https://projects.halit.org/omodroid/omoda-5-launcher): what Chery's documents say about the Omoda 5 screen, what is unknown, how to follow the first release ([Turkish](https://projects.halit.org/omodroid/tr/omoda-5-launcher))
- [Blog](https://projects.halit.org/omodroid/blog/): background notes on Android Auto, head units, CarPlay and CAN bus, sourced from Google, Apple and Chery documents

## Blog

- [Android Auto not working or not connecting: a checklist](https://projects.halit.org/omodroid/blog/android-auto-not-working): Android Auto not working or not connecting? Check the phone, the USB cable, the car's settings and wireless pairing, step by step from Google's own help pages.
- [Android Auto, Android head units and car launchers compared](https://projects.halit.org/omodroid/blog/android-auto-vs-head-unit): Android Auto, an Android head unit and a car launcher are three different things. What each one is, where apps run, and which one fits what you want to do.
- [Why YouTube video does not play in Android Auto, and what is changing](https://projects.halit.org/omodroid/blog/android-auto-youtube-limitations): Android Auto YouTube limitations: Google allows audio, not video, while driving. What Google's docs say about parked video and the announced rollout.
- [Apple CarPlay on an Android head unit: how it works](https://projects.halit.org/omodroid/blog/carplay-on-android-head-unit): How Apple CarPlay can run on an Android head unit, what Apple requires, why it depends on the unit vendor, and what to check before you buy or set one up.
- [What a wireless Android Auto adapter does](https://projects.halit.org/omodroid/blog/wireless-android-auto-adapter): Wireless Android Auto adapters explained: what they do, what your phone and car need for wireless Android Auto per Google, and what to check before buying one.
- [How to check whether your car supports Android Auto](https://projects.halit.org/omodroid/blog/android-auto-supported-cars): Which cars support Android Auto? Use Google's official compatibility list, check wired vs wireless with the maker, and confirm your phone and country qualify.
- [Omoda 5 multimedya ekranı: belgelerde ne yazıyor?](https://projects.halit.org/omodroid/blog/omoda-5-multimedya): Chery Omoda 5 multimedya ekranı özellikleri: ekran boyutu, Apple CarPlay ve Android Auto, USB ve ses sistemi. Chery belgelerinden derlendi, kaynakları ile.
- [CAN bus basics for Android head unit projects](https://projects.halit.org/omodroid/blog/android-head-unit-canbus): What CAN bus is, why Android head units need it for steering wheel buttons and car data, and why a pinout needs a source for your exact car before you wire it.
- [README](https://github.com/halitsever/omodroid/blob/main/Readme.md): project summary and current status
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/halitsever/omodroid/blob/main/AGENTS.md): CI check and conventions for contributors
